### GrabAGun Statement on ATF Guidance


October 20, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s206.q4cdn.com/956379955/files/doc_news/GrabAGun-Statement-on-ATF-Guidance-2026.pdf)


COPPELL, Texas--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


GrabAGun Digital Holdings Inc. (“GrabAGun” or the “Company”) (NYSE:PEW) unapologetically supports the Second Amendment and applauds the Texas federal court’s decision in *Silencer Shop Foundation v. ATF* and ATF’s October 9, 2026 guidance. These are decisive victories for law-abiding Americans’ civil rights. The guidance ends federal enforcement of NFA registration and prior-approval requirements for suppressors, short-barreled rifles and shotguns, and other covered untaxed firearms. We thank President Trump for making this relief possible. We also thank ATF, Director Robert Cekada, Chief Counsel Robert Leider, and all of the agency’s hard-working staff.


Law-abiding Americans have every reason to celebrate. In *Heller* , the Supreme Court recognized that “the inherent right of self-defense has been central to the Second Amendment right.” *McDonald* made that right “fully applicable to the States.” In *Bruen* , Justice Thomas rejected treating armed self-defense as “a second-class right, subject to an entirely different body of rules than the other Bill of Rights guarantees.”


Our right to keep and bear arms comes from our Creator. The Second Amendment commands that it “shall not be infringed.” Blackstone recognized “the natural right of resistance and self-preservation.” Madison, writing as Publius, celebrated “the advantage of being armed, which the Americans possess over the people of almost every other nation.” ATF’s guidance is the latest salvo in the fight to give these rights their full protection.


The momentum is in favor of our rights, and we are determined to build on it. The *Silencer Shop* ruling and ATF’s October 9, 2026 guidance were both major steps forward. But there is more work to be done to remove the unconstitutional infringements on citizens’ Second Amendment Rights and to fully implement President Trump’s Executive Order 14206 to remove any ongoing infringements and protect the Second Amendment rights of all Americans.


GrabAGun is a Texas-based online firearms retailer that has helped Americans exercise their Second Amendment rights for more than fifteen years. We support the legal work that protects our customers’ civil rights. We are Platinum supporters of the Second Amendment Foundation and have also sponsored SAF’s Gun Rights Policy Conference. Our customers depend on these freedoms, and we will keep defending them.


**About GrabAGun Digital Holdings Inc.**


GrabAGun Digital Holdings Inc. (NYSE: PEW) is a technology-driven commerce and platform company serving the firearms, ammunition, and outdoor industry through two complementary businesses. GrabAGun.com, the Company’s digitally native eCommerce retailer operated by wholly-owned subsidiary GrabAGun LLC, is one of the nation’s leading online firearms retailers, built on fifteen years of proprietary software development spanning dynamic inventory and order management, AI-powered pricing, demand forecasting, and automated regulatory compliance. PEW Logistics LLC, the Company's wholly-owned platform services subsidiary, extends that proven infrastructure to firearms manufacturers as a turnkey e-commerce solution generating recurring, high-margin platform revenue across fulfillment, compliance, data, and marketing services. Together, these businesses position GrabAGun as the technology backbone of a modernized firearms supply chain, with a capital-efficient model that monetizes the infrastructure the Company has already built.
